## Raw second transcription

```yaml
lines:
  - id: dependent.one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One, for each person listed in the Dependents section"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dependent.one}

  - id: dependent.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  - id: dependent.h_rel_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A qualifying child is your son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, brother, sister, stepbrother, stepsister, half brother, half sister, or a descendant of any of them"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling_descendant"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_age_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 19 at the end of 2025 and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly); or under age 24 at the end of 2025, a full-time student, and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly); or any age and permanently and totally disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.student_age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.student, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.disabled, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_resident
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Who lived with you for more than half of 2025 (see Exception to time lived with you and Kidnapped child)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.kidnapped, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {const: 18, type: Count}]}
    note: "Pub. 501 treats a kidnapped child as meeting the residency test only if the child lived with you for more than half of the part of the year before the kidnapping (or after the return), until the year the child is determined to be dead or would have reached age 18. No input gives the part-year residence or a determination of death. Chosen reading: a yes to the kidnapped question meets the test while the child is under 18 at the end of 2025."

  - id: dependent.h_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1. Do you have a child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.self_support, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_resident, {const: true}]}
    note: "Qualifying child of more than one person: the tiebreaker rules turn on who the child's parents are and on other persons' AGI, for which there is no input. Chosen reading: listing the person means the filer is the one who claims the child under those rules, so a yes to other_claimant does not remove the child here."

  - id: dependent.h_rel_listed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 relatives who don't have to live with you: son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, or a descendant; brother, sister, half brother, half sister, or a son or daughter of any of them; father, mother, or an ancestor or sibling of either of them; stepbrother, stepsister, stepfather, stepmother, or in-law"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent_relative"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "in_law"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 1. Does any person meet the conditions to be your qualifying relative?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_listed, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.spouse_relative, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.qr_all_year, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.lawful, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_claimant, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_nontaxpayer, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.gross_income, {param: qr.gross_income_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.supported, {const: true}]}
    note: "Two points are not encoded because no input carries them: the sheltered-workshop exclusion from gross income for a permanently and totally disabled person, and the Pub. 501 kidnapped-child rule for a qualifying relative. The gross income and all-year answers are used as given."

  - id: dependent.claimed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim this person as a dependent (Steps 2 and 4)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.canada_mexico, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.married, dependent.multiple_support]
    note: "The question 'Could you be claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 tax return?' is asked only when no joint return is filed. It is read from sa.dependent, which also covers a spouse and dual-status aliens. Married persons, children of divorced or separated parents and multiple support agreements are refused."

  - id: dependent.ctc_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3. You can claim the child tax credit for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: ctc.age_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.work_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.any_work_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
    note: "The filer's side of Step 3, question 4 (one spouse with an SSN valid for employment, the other with an SSN or ITIN issued by the due date) is read from household.any_work_ssn and household.all_tin. Their meaning is inferred from their names, because the catalog gives no formulas."

  - id: dependent.odc_person
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim the credit for other dependents for this person (Step 3, question 3, and Step 5)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.id_count, household.persons]}
    note: "The requirement that you, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN or ITIN issued (or an ITIN applied for) by the due date is read as household.all_tin, or otherwise household.id_count equal to household.persons. Reading id_count as the number of filers with a number issued or applied for is a guess from its name."

  - id: dependent.h_ctc_per_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,200 (Schedule 8812, line 5)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ctc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.ctc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's part of Schedule 8812, line 5: $2,200 for a qualifying child under age 17 with the required social security number"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_ctc_per_child
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.h_odc_per_dependent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$500 (Schedule 8812, line 7)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: odc.per_dependent}

  - id: dependent.odc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's part of Schedule 8812, line 7: $500 for each other dependent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_odc_per_dependent
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.h_actc_per_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$1,700 (Schedule 8812, line 16b)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: actc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.actc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's part of Schedule 8812, line 16b: $1,700 for each qualifying child under age 17 with the required social security number"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_actc_per_child
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.h_hoh_lived
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lived with you for more than half of the year (head of household, Test 2, with the Exception to time lived with you)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.kidnapped, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {const: 18, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.born_died, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.placed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.part_year_home, {const: true}]}
    note: "The Pub. 501 conditions for a kidnapped child are cut off in the supplied text. The reading is the same as for the residency test (a yes counts while the child is under 18)."

  - id: dependent.h_hoh_base
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A person who can qualify you under head of household Test 2, before checking the absences counted as time lived with you"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_hoh_lived, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_listed, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.married, dependent.multiple_support]
    note: "With married persons refused, every qualifying child counts, whether a dependent (item 1) or not (item 2). A dependent who is not a qualifying child counts unless the person is a dependent only because the person lived with you all year, that is, not a listed relative of yours."

  - id: dependent.hoh_absence
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person would qualify you under Test 2 only by counting an absence from which it was not reasonable to assume the absent person would return, or during which you did not keep up the home"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_hoh_base, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: true}]}
    note: "Pub. 501 counts a temporary absence only if it is reasonable to assume the absent person will return and you keep up the home. When such an absence was counted, the months answer does not settle Test 2, so the person is flagged here and left out of hoh_test2."

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 2. A person who lived with you for more than half of the year and is a person you can claim as a dependent (other than one who is your dependent only because the person lived with you all year) or your unmarried qualifying child who isn't your dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_hoh_base, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 1. You paid over half the cost of keeping up a home that was the main home for all of 2025 of your parent whom you can claim as a dependent, except under a multiple support agreement"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.parent_home_paid, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.eic_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Step 3. A child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child for the purpose of claiming the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.us_half, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.kidnapped, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {const: 18, type: Count}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.divorced_rule]
    note: "There is no support test for the EIC. A married child and a child under the divorced-or-separated-parents rule are refused. Pub. 596, which has the kidnapped-child rule for the EIC, is not in the supplied text, so the dependent-rule reading is reused. The tiebreaker reading is the same as for the qualifying child test."

  - id: dependent.eic_ssn_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A qualifying child for the EIC who has a valid SSN (issued on or before the due date of your return, including extensions)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_dc_lived
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lived with you for more than half the year (a person who was born or died in 2025 is treated as having lived with you for more than half of 2025 if your home was the person's home more than half the time they were alive in 2025)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.born_died, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.part_year_home, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.dc_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying person for Form 2441: a qualifying child under age 13 whom you can claim as a dependent, or a person who wasn't physically or mentally able to care for themselves, lived with you for more than half the year and whom you can claim as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_dc_lived, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_under13, {const: true}]}
    note: "Only persons you can claim are covered here. Persons who would be dependents but for gross income, a joint return or your own dependency, and the custodial-parent rule, are left to the Form 2441 screening question. A child who is 13 at the end of 2025 was under 13 for part of the year and qualifies if any of the care claimed was before the 13th birthday."

  - id: dependent.dc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One qualifying person (counted for Form 2441 where this person is a qualifying person)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dc.one}
    note: "The IRS pages do not define a per-person count. A choose cannot select a Count, so this is the constant 1 for the entry. A reader that counts qualifying persons must add it only over entries where dependent.dc_qp is true."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2d
    printed: "2(d)"
    label: "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025 for the person listed in column (a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.dc_paid
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp
    note: "Line 30 says not to include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28. That is a return-level amount with no per-person allocation in the text, so this line is the person's expenses before that reduction and Form 2441 must apply it."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2c
    printed: "2(c)"
    label: "Check here if the qualifying person was over age 12 and was disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, gt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_over12_care, {const: true}]}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp
    note: "A person 14 or older at the end of 2025 was over age 12 all year. A person who is 13 at the end of 2025 turned 13 during the year, so the box depends on whether any included care was provided at age 13 or older while the person was unable to care for themselves."

  - id: dependent.ptc_magi_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This dependent's modified AGI included on Form 8962, line 2b (dependents who are required to file an income tax return because their income meets the filing threshold)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.ptc_magi
        - guard:
            op: test
            not:
              op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero

  - id: dependent.h_edu_student
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A dependent you claim for whom qualified education expenses were paid, who received Form 1098-T (or meets its exceptions) and was issued a TIN by the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_1098t, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The student qualifies for the American opportunity credit (lines 23 through 26, the institution's EIN, and TINs issued by the due date)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line23, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line24, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line25, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line26, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_ein, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
    note: "When the American opportunity credit is available it is taken over the lifetime learning credit, since the instructions say it will always be greater. A student without the institution's EIN, or whose filers lack an issued TIN, falls to the lifetime learning credit. The filers' TIN requirement is read from household.all_tin, whose meaning is inferred from its name."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The student's expenses go to line 31 (lifetime learning credit)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_adj_sum
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 3. Total adjustments (add lines 2a, 2b, and 2c)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_a2025, dependent.edu_a2026, dependent.edu_refunds]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_over_refused
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "An academic period's tax-free assistance and refunds were more than that period's expenses (the worksheet must be completed separately for each academic period)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [dependent.h_edu_adj_sum, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_over, {const: true}]}
    note: "The worksheet is completed for each academic period, but the inputs are yearly totals. The totals give the same result unless one period's adjustments exceed its expenses, and that case is refused."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_expenses
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 1. Total qualified education expenses paid for or on behalf of the student in 2025 (American opportunity credit: tuition, required fees and course materials)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_inst, dependent.edu_mat]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_adjusted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 4. Adjusted qualified education expenses. Subtract line 3 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0- (American opportunity credit)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.h_edu_aoc_expenses, take: dependent.h_edu_adj_sum}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_cap
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.expense_cap}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_capped
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses. Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [dependent.h_edu_aoc_adjusted, dependent.h_edu_cap]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_edu_aoc_capped
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_line27, take: {param: aoc.full_band}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Multiply line 28 by 25% (0.25)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: dependent.edu_line28, rate: {param: aoc.second_rate}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_edu_band
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.full_band}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_line29_plus
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add $2,000 to the amount on line 29"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_line29, dependent.h_edu_band]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "If line 28 is zero, enter the amount from line 27. Otherwise, add $2,000 to the amount on line 29 and enter the result. Skip line 31. Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 30, on Part I, line 1"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}
          then: dependent.edu_line27
        - guard: {op: test, ne: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}
          then: dependent.h_edu_line29_plus
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_edu_llc_adjusted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted Qualified Education Expenses Worksheet, line 4. Adjusted qualified education expenses. Subtract line 3 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0- (lifetime learning credit: tuition, required fees and amounts required to be paid to the institution)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_inst, take: dependent.h_edu_adj_sum}

  - id: dependent.edu_line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 31, on Part II, line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: true}]}
          then: dependent.h_edu_llc_adjusted
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: false}]}
          then: dependent.h_zero
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_llc
    note: "Return-level conditions for the education credits (filing status, MAGI, being claimed as a dependent, nonresident alien status) are left to Form 8863."
```

<!-- end -->
